tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Look up an order. Example: call with {"order_id": "ord_1"} and get {"id": "ord_1", "status": "shipped", "items": [{"sku": "A", "quantity": 2, "price": 1999}], "total": 3998, "events": [{"type": "created"}, {"type": "paid"}, {"type": "shipped"}]}. Another example: {"order_id": "ord_2"}.
